shortDescription: Australia's FleetPartners ASX:FPR said on Monday it had received revised offers from SG Fleet, Japan's ORIX TSE:8591 and a consortium led by Sumitomo Corp TSE:8053, valuing the vehicle leasing firm at up to A$982.1 million ($702.2 million).FleetPartners' stock jumped nearly 12% to a record high of…

children: said on Monday it had received revised offers from SG Fleet, Japan's ORIX
and a consortium led by Sumitomo Corp
, valuing the vehicle leasing firm at up to A$982.1 million ($702.2 million).
FleetPartners' stock jumped nearly 12% to a record high of A$4.6 as of 0027 GMT.
SG Fleet has increased its offer to A$4.55 per share, while ORIX and Sumitomo have raised their individual offers to A$4.65.
The sweetened offers value the company at between A$960.9 million and A$982.1 million, topping SG Fleet's previous leading bid of A$844.8 million.
FleetPartners added that Canada's Element Fleet
has dropped out of the race after opting not to submit a revised proposal.
The board has decided to grant each of SG Fleet, ORIX and the Sumitomo Consortium access to a further phase of due diligence, the firm added.
